body:
This makes the implemented Spatial Studio directly reviewable through 15 real production-browser screenshots, a labeled contact sheet and a source-bound visual assessment. Captured product source is protected main `f458bf2dc1176016c2d166180f038f0f15ac9f7c`; all account, library and Chronicle records are synthetic and use the real authorization/persistence paths.

Open `Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/Spatial_Studio_Visual_Review_20261011.md` for individual GitHub image links, mode differences, responsive layouts, library/version/attachment/publication states and visible limitations. Owner visual acceptance remains pending. No Parallax redesign or later phase is included.

Validation: isolated production capture journey 1/1 PASS; actual images inspected and scroll-settling corrected; documentation validation, Feature Catalog sync/validation and whitespace checks PASS. This draft publishes independently reviewable evidence; it is not protected-main acceptance or owner acceptance. Crossdeck transport will use a separate candidate.
